part.text:
Fixed. The bug: FCALL/FCALL_RO are marked `CMD_SKIP_MONITOR` (like EVAL), but unlike `evalCommand`/`evalShaCommand`, `fcallCommandGeneric` never fed the monitors explicitly — so `fcall` never appeared in MONITOR output.

Change: in `src/functions.c:618`, added the explicit monitor feed at the top of `fcallCommandGeneric`, matching the existing pattern in `src/eval.c:554`:

```c
/* Functions need to be fed to monitors before the commands they execute. */
replicationFeedMonitors(c,server.monitors,c->db->id,c->argv,c->argc);
```

Verified: rebuilt the server and ran `unit/introspection` (includes the new "MONITOR can log commands issued by functions" test) and `unit/functions` — all tests pass.
